about: Generated by conformance/family_oracle (make family-vectors). Do not edit by hand.
Every derived value comes from the independent Python oracle, never from Rust.
Rust tests read the inputs, recompute the outputs, and compare.
The cases are the registered vectors of quip/charged-ice revision 1, generated by charge.py.

The energies section holds four spin states for each salt of each case: all +1, all -1, alternating by dense position (+1 at even positions), and one seeded state. The seeded state draws uniform(2) per node, in dense position order, from the ChaCha8 stream whose seed is the BLAKE3 of the label energy-state followed by the 32 byte salt nonce. A draw of 0 gives +1 and a draw of 1 gives -1.

Each state records spins_hex with one byte per node (01 for +1 and ff for -1). It records encoded_milli (the sum of J s s and h s over the instance, plus the offset), direct_milli (the sum of the squared tile penalties and the background couplings, from a function that never reads h, the offset, or the J of a tile edge), and charge_defects. The two energies are equal.
The recipe section holds the ice-charge parameter set on the live z(12, 4) topology with two salts. It stores hashes and counts, not instances.
The admission section holds requests with their expected admission codes.
